episode.title: Prevent cache warming from overwriting the normal max-token budget
episode.before: At parent commit 8fb0362b479a6ab29e11b0432a7f698b926d0bbb, the cache-warming worker reuses the model's mutable extra-parameter mapping, sets max_tokens to 1 for a warming ping, and thereby leaves later foreground and prefill-capable completions with the one-token limit. The prefill continuation path can then repeatedly issue one-token responses, matching the loop and rapid-charge symptom reported by the issue.
episode.after: At pinned commit f2e1e177414bad2a50fb99b73b06d575f722a690, the cache-warming worker copies the model parameter mapping before applying max_tokens=1. The warming request remains bounded, while the model's configured normal completion budget remains available to subsequent foreground, history, repository, and prefill-capable requests.
episode.diff: The implementation-bearing commit changes only aider/coders/base_coder.py and replaces one assignment in the cache-warming worker: kwargs = self.main_model.extra_params or dict() becomes kwargs = dict(self.main_model.extra_params) or dict(). The subsequent max_tokens=1 override and provider call are unchanged. No tests are changed; existing tests cover cache-option activation but not isolation of the warming parameters from the normal completion parameters.

evidence_units.claim: The issue title reports that v0.58 entered a loop and rapidly incurred charges; the bundle has no issue body, comments, timeline, or linked pull-request discussion.

The evidence bundle anchors issue 1842 to resolved commit f2e1e177414bad2a50fb99b73b06d575f722a690 with parent 8fb0362b479a6ab29e11b0432a7f698b926d0bbb; the only changed file is aider/coders/base_coder.py.

The pinned commit subject identifies the failure mechanism as stomping extra_params[max_tokens]=1 during cache warming, producing one-token infinite-output responses with prefill models, and references issue 1842.

The parent-to-pinned diff changes exactly one assignment in the cache-warming worker: self.main_model.extra_params or dict() becomes dict(self.main_model.extra_params) or dict(); the subsequent max_tokens=1 assignment is unchanged.
In the parent warm_cache worker, a truthy self.main_model.extra_params object is assigned directly to kwargs and then mutated with kwargs['max_tokens'] = 1 before the provider call.

In the pinned warm_cache worker, kwargs is initialized from a new dict copy of self.main_model.extra_params and then given the temporary max_tokens=1 override before being expanded into the warming completion request.
Cache warming is gated by cache headers and a positive ping count, schedules the configured number of delayed pings, and send_message invokes warm_cache immediately before the foreground send loop.
evidence_units.source: git show f2e1e177414bad2a50fb99b73b06d575f722a690:aider/coders/base_coder.py, lines 1050-1112; aider/main.py, lines 605-633; aider/args.py, lines 253-265

evidence_units.claim: The foreground send path passes model.extra_params to send_completion, and send_completion merges that mapping into the provider kwargs; therefore a persistent mutation of the model mapping affects later normal requests.

When a completion ends because of the output length limit, send_message treats a model supporting assistant prefill as continuable, appends or updates an assistant-prefill message, and retries the send loop; a max_tokens=1 mutation can therefore repeat one-token continuations.

Built-in cache-capable model settings in the pinned checkout carry extra_params mappings, including normal max_tokens values of 8192 for the Sonnet and OpenRouter cache settings; the model settings type itself declares extra_params as Optional[dict].

Other completion consumers, including history summarization and commit-message generation, also pass model.extra_params through simple_send_with_retries, so preserving the model-level mapping protects more than the main chat path.
evidence_units.source: git show f2e1e177414bad2a50fb99b73b06d575f722a690:aider/history.py, lines 104-118; aider/repo.py, lines 189-199; aider/sendchat.py, lines 91-103

evidence_units.claim: The pinned checkout's existing cache tests verify cache-option wiring: Sonnet with --cache-prompts initializes cache headers, while the 4o path does not; they do not invoke warm_cache or assert that extra_params or max_tokens is preserved.
evidence_units.source: git show f2e1e177414bad2a50fb99b73b06d575f722a690:tests/basic/test_main.py, lines 533-572; repository-wide search of tests excluding fixtures for warm_cache, cache_warming, extra_params, and max_tokens

evidence_units.claim: The parent-to-pinned diff passes git diff --check, and the diff is limited to the one-line cache-warming parameter-isolation change.

candidate_atomics.name: localize_cache_warming_budget_override
candidate_atomics.description: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

semantic_action.intent: Bound each cache-warming provider request to one output token without permanently reducing the normal completion budget or triggering repeated one-token prefill continuations.
semantic_action.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.
semantic_action.pre_state: The warming worker aliases the model's extra-parameter mapping, overwrites its max_tokens entry with 1, and the normal send path later consumes that same mapping.
semantic_action.post_state: The warming worker uses a distinct kwargs mapping with max_tokens=1, while the model's extra_params retains its configured entries, such as the normal max_tokens budget, for later requests.
semantic_action.validation: The parent and pinned diff plus the call sites provide a static invariant oracle: the warming completion consumes the copied kwargs while the foreground path still consumes model.extra_params. Existing cache-option tests cover activation only; a mocked-provider regression test for both the one-token warm ping and preserved normal budget is absent.

candidate_workflows.name: preserve_foreground_budget_during_cache_keepalive
candidate_workflows.description: For an enabled prompt-cache keepalive flow, isolate the one-token maintenance override from the shared model configuration so delayed cache pings remain bounded and later prefill-capable completions retain their normal output budget.

workflow_graph.goal: Keep the prompt cache alive with bounded maintenance calls while preserving the foreground completion budget and avoiding a one-token prefill loop.
workflow_graph.entry_state: Prompt-cache keepalive is enabled for a cache-capable model; send_message schedules or runs cache warming before the foreground send, and the parent implementation shares the model extra-parameter mapping with the warming request.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Each warming request receives max_tokens=1 through a local kwargs copy, the model extra_params mapping remains unchanged for foreground and prefill-capable calls, and the length-continuation path is no longer forced into one-token responses by cache warming.
unresolved_or_deferred: The checkout has no targeted regression test that mocks the warming provider and asserts both the one-token warm request and preservation of the next normal request's configured max_tokens.

ModelSettings declares extra_params as Optional[dict], while the pinned expression calls dict(...) without an explicit None guard; built-in cache-capable settings inspected here provide mappings, but the custom or None case remains unresolved.
The cache-disabled and zero-ping early-return branches are unchanged by the commit and are not represented as separate change actions.

unresolved_questions: The issue body, comments, timeline, and linked pull-request discussion are unavailable, so user-level confirmation beyond the issue title and commit is not recoverable.
The repository contains no direct warm-cache regression test; behavioral validation of request isolation and the prevented prefill loop remains deferred.
The local environment could not launch Python, so the existing cache-option tests could not be executed here; validation is limited to checkout inspection and git diff --check.

Does any supported or custom cache-capable model reach warm_cache with extra_params=None? The pinned fix assumes dict(self.main_model.extra_params) is valid, while the model field is typed Optional[dict].
